text:
Alex S.: HelixCorp just confirmed a 2-week POC. Goal: streaming SDK -> function/tool calls -> structured JSON outputs for live moderation and reranking. They want a demo next Tue. Need eng + security + pricing input.
Priya (SE): I can own the POC runbook. Quick Qs: what's their latency SLO and token distribution? Also, do they require on-prem connectivity (VPC) or is hosted ok for trial?
Mateo (Eng): I can cover runtime tweaks. Two immediate concerns: they occasionally send ~30k token contexts and want tail latency <250ms; and their edge uses a corporate proxy that kills long-lived SSE connections. We should plan a websocket fallback and a short heartbeat.
Zora (Security): I’ll start the security questionnaire. HelixCorp requires SAML SSO + customer-managed KMS and proof of SOC2. We can meet SAML/KMS on Dedicated/Private; hosted needs an attestation copy of SOC2. Ask them for the exact fields in the questionnaire (data retention, export controls).
Alex S.: Sending their security PDF: https://files.example.com/helixcorp/sec-q-2026.pdf
Priya (SE): Mateo can you drop a minimal streaming handshake + example payload we can give to their infra team? Also, include an example of a function/tool call wire message and a structured output schema.
Mateo (Eng): Yep — sample below. Use short TTL ephemeral creds for the demo. curl example and a small node snippet.
Mateo (Eng): ```
# Handshake (SSE) - client -> Redwood
POST /v1/streams/start HTTP/1.1
Host: inference.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <EPHEMERAL_TOKEN>
Content-Type: application/json
Prefer: handshake=streaming;fallback=websocket

{"model":"rwd-stream-2b","max_tokens":4096,"interactive":true}

# Server will upgrade and stream event lines with trace-id header
```
Mateo (Eng): Example streaming event (tool call triggered):
```json
event: message
data: {"role":"assistant","type":"tool.call","tool":"moderation","args":{"text":"..."},"trace_id":"trace-abc-123"}
```
Mateo (Eng): Structured output example after tool returns:
```json
{"choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"content":{"type":"structured","schema":"{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"safety\":{\"type\":\"string\"}}}","value":{"safety":"allowed"}}}}]}
```
Priya (SE): Perfect. For backpressure, can we give them recommended client-side retry/backoff and server chunking configs?
Mateo (Eng): Yes — suggest: client window=8 concurrent in-flight tokens, keep heartbeat every 20s, reconnect with exponential backoff jitter. On server: enable prefix KV cache for repeated contexts and auto-batch size=32 for lower p50 cost.
Roxanne (Finance): Pricing note: for a 2-week Dedicated trial with 1 x A10G equiv reserved for peak (expected 4-6 vGPU-days total) + trial support, we can offer a $7k trial credit. If they want a committed monthly Dedicated plan for production, quote will start at $18k/mo for the baseline capacity they described. This is rough — fine to give as ballpark.
Alex S.: Good. Helix asked about cost of function/tool calls per invocation vs tokens — can we state that tool execution is charged as a small fixed unit + token cost for the payload? (they care because they call external moderation per turn)
Roxanne (Finance): Yes. Policy: function/tool calls = $0.002 per call + standard per-token inference pricing. We'll include example math in the deck.
Zora (Security): Action item: get their SAML metadata and KMS keypolicy snippet. Also confirm if they need audit-log streaming to their SIEM (we support delivery via syslog/HTTP collector on Dedicated/Private).
Priya (SE): I'll compile a one-page runbook for the demo: steps to generate ephemeral creds, handshake snippet, fallback websocket, sample payload schema, and escalation contacts. Will also include the pricing ballpark and SOC2 attestation note.
integrations-bot: ephemeral token issued (valid 02:00:00) — token id: tok-demo-helix-1723 (for demo only)
Alex S.: Demo scheduling: Tue 10am PT. Priya, Mateo, Zora attending. Helix wants a live end-to-end where we push a 10k token doc and trigger moderation tool + structured output. Please confirm readiness by Monday EOD.
Priya (SE): Confirmed. I'll send calendar and runbook PR to the Helix contact and add a short test script they can run behind their proxy.
Mateo (Eng): I'll prepare a small docker image with websocket fallback and a sample load generator (links + quick run instructions). Will post image link by Monday.
Zora (Security): I'll email Helix security lead for the questionnaire clarifications and confirm the KMS policy format.
Alex S.: Thanks team — this is high priority. If any blockers pop up (proxy or token limits) call me and we can escalate to eng-sre.
